sentences.text: Shri Ajay Mishra, learned senior counsel with Shri Laven Arora and Arpit Tiwari, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Shri Pramod Choubey, learned Government Advocate for the respondent-State.

The contention of the petitioner is that the provision of Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 has not been complied with and also that the criminal complaint is pending since last 17 years without having examined any of the prosecution witness.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent- State is directed to seek instructions as to whether compliance has been made or not?
If made, provide copy of the intimation or analysis report given to the complainant.
If on the next date of hearing, the same is not produced, the Court would be constrained to pass order of staying the further proceeding of the criminal complaint case pending before the trial Court.

(SUSHIL KUMAR PALO) JUDGE ac/-
